name: growth
description: The one that judges how you worked, not what you produced. Compares your week against the priorities you confirmed, ranks what is in front of you against them, keeps a running record of what actually went well in your own words, and gives feedback against a standard you set. Needs the files setup writes, and time-spent needs a configured calendar; source-based runs open by naming the evidence and the dates they actually read. Nothing here writes except the wins record, and only with your yes.
